buildCommand:
git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 && export PATH="$PATH:`pwd`/flutter/bin" && flutter config --enable-web && printf 'R2_ENDPOINT=%s
R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID=%s
R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=%s
R2_BUCKET=%s
R2_PUBLIC_URL=%s
' "$R2_ENDPOINT" "$R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "$R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" "$R2_BUCKET" "$R2_PUBLIC_URL" > .env && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release
